CustomField.description: Working days requested, calculated in the before-insert trigger from Term_From__c..Term_To__c excluding weekends and Holiday records, with Period_Leave__c applied only to single-day requests. Replaces the No_of_Days__c formula, which is structurally limited to 1 or 0.5 and cannot represent a multi-day request. No_of_Days__c is retained until nothing references it.
CustomField.label: Leave Days
